browser_verification_notes.pocket-pause: Wish creation, ready review, manual linked deposit, reversal, and reload observed in localhost UI. Storage clock regressions covered by automated tests.
browser_verification_notes.deadlock-manor: Completed incident, same-checkpoint causal comparison, and alternative-branch confirmation observed in localhost UI.
browser_verification_notes.iqiyi-play-lab: Calibration controls and persisted manual timing offset observed in localhost UI; tap-estimator boundaries covered by automated tests.
browser_verification_notes.scene-clearance-lab: Browser WebGL2 context unavailable; usable top-down fallback observed. Original glTF import, numeric layout commit, geometric update, snapshots and reload observed. Full WebGL rendering remains unverified in this environment.
browser_verification_notes.paper-route-playtest: Observed full 12-step autoplay victory/return, hint without acting, and mutant counterexample where step 4 falsely delivers only in the mutant. No console errors.
browser_verification_notes.lumen-shift: Observed first-board victory, undo/redo, next-board hint, and completed-board persistence after reload. Replay-allowance hint boundary covered by automated regression.
browser_verification_notes.parallax-postcards: Observed legal reading/navigation/alignment/capture in all three rooms, 3/3 completion, ending and restored progress after reload. No console errors. Canvas2D rendering observed.
browser_verification_notes.patch-review-desk: Local API role/authorization probe observed actual action schemas, successful authorized inspect and unauthorized 401. Browser-authenticated file mutation was not manually exercised; approval/apply/rollback paths covered by tests.
